summary: Implements LocalReporter (HTTP POST with bearer auth and credential caching) and MultiReporter (parallel fan-out) for metrics, logfwd, and auditfwd pipelines. Wiring in up.go conditionally wraps reporters when LocalEndpoint.URL is configured. Reference docs updated for all three observability pipelines. All tests pass with -race. Core pattern is sound: double-checked RWMutex credential cache, stale fallback, parallel dispatch with platform-error-only return. Three consistency issues across the pipeline implementations need resolution, and unrelated doc changes should be reverted.

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows existing code patterns (interface implementation, error format, doc comments)
Functions are single-responsibility and appropriately sized
Magic numbers use named constants consistently across packages
HTTP transport construction is consistent across all three packages
Log warning messages follow consistent format across packages
Response body drain pattern is consistent across packages

security_checklist.item: Bearer token never appears in log output (verified by capturingHandler test in metrics)
Error messages do not leak cryptographic details (ciphertext, nonce, NSK)
Credential cache protected by sync.RWMutex with double-checked locking
TLS InsecureSkipVerify is opt-in with nolint:gosec comment
HTTP client has 10s timeout preventing resource exhaustion
No hardcoded secrets in code or tests (test secrets generated via AES-256-GCM)

architecture_checklist.item: LocalReporter creates its own http.Client independent of ControlPlane client
MultiReporter implements correct reporter interface per pipeline
Parallel dispatch via goroutines + WaitGroup, platform error returned, local error logged
Conditional wrapping in up.go — no MultiReporter when URL empty
SecretFetcher interface defined per-consumer package (idiomatic Go)
No behavioral change for existing deployments without local endpoint

dry_yagni_checklist.item: Three LocalReporter implementations acceptable (each implements different interface)

fail_fast_checklist.item: Credential resolution errors fail fast when no cache exists
Non-2xx HTTP responses return descriptive errors

architecture_findings.description: Scope creep: 8 documentation files changed outside the feature scope (docs/.vitepress/config.mts, docs/.vitepress/theme/custom.css, docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts, docs/concepts.md, docs/guide/agent-lifecycle.md deleted, docs/guide/architecture.md, docs/guide/platform-communication.md, docs/index.md). These consolidate agent-lifecycle into architecture and remove custom CSS — unrelated to PXD-0047 LocalReporter/MultiReporter feature.
architecture_findings.fix: Revert all doc changes not in docs/reference/observability/. The architecture consolidation should be a separate commit/PR.

issues_found.description: logfwd NewLocalReporter creates bare &http.Transport{} when TLSInsecureSkipVerify=true, instead of cloning http.DefaultTransport. This discards default transport settings (connection pooling, keep-alives, proxy, dial timeouts), degrading performance when TLS skip is configured. Metrics and auditfwd correctly use http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone().
issues_found.fix: Align with metrics/auditfwd pattern: transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone(); if cfg.TLSInsecureSkipVerify { transport.TLSClientConfig = &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true} }; return &LocalReporter{httpClient: &http.Client{Timeout: defaultHTTPTimeout, Transport: transport}, ...}

issues_found.description: auditfwd resolveToken logs 'auditfwd: using stale cached credential' with component='auditfwd', embedding the package name redundantly in both the message string and the structured attribute. Metrics and logfwd log 'using cached credential' with component=<pkg>. This inconsistency makes log queries fragile.
issues_found.fix: Change to r.logger.Warn("using cached credential", "component", "auditfwd", "error", err) to match metrics and logfwd.

issues_found.description: logfwd and auditfwd use magic literals '5 * time.Minute' and '10 * time.Second' for cache TTL and HTTP timeout. Metrics correctly defines 'const defaultCacheTTL = 5 * time.Minute'. All three packages should name these constants for maintainability.
issues_found.fix: Add 'const (defaultCacheTTL = 5 * time.Minute; defaultHTTPTimeout = 10 * time.Second)' to logfwd and auditfwd local_reporter.go, matching the metrics pattern.

issues_found.description: logfwd and auditfwd MultiReporter tests are missing SlowLocalDoesNotBlockPlatform and ContextCancellation test cases. The plan tasks 1.4 and 1.6 specify 'same test scenarios as metrics MultiReporter'. These tests verify REQ-005 (local failure never blocks platform) which is a critical business requirement.
issues_found.fix: Add delay field to logfwd/auditfwd stubReporter/multiMockReporter. Add TestMultiReporter_SlowLocalDoesNotBlockPlatform and TestMultiReporter_ContextCancellation tests following the metrics pattern.

issues_found.description: logfwd and auditfwd TestLocalReporter_UsesStaleCacheOnFetchError tests use discardLogger and do not verify that the warning was actually logged. REQ-002 requires 'warning log includes the fetch error'. The metrics equivalent correctly captures and asserts the warning.
issues_found.fix: Replace discardLogger() with capturingHandler-backed logger in stale-fallback tests. Assert that the warning message 'using cached credential' was emitted with the fetch error.

issues_found.description: TestMultiReporter_BothFail in logfwd (and metrics) uses discardLogger(). REQ-006 both-fail scenario requires 'the local error is logged as a warning', but this is not asserted.
issues_found.fix: Use capturingHandler and assert the warning log in TestMultiReporter_BothFail.

issues_found.description: metrics and logfwd LocalReporters do not drain the response body before closing (defer resp.Body.Close() only), while auditfwd correctly does io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body). Not draining prevents HTTP keep-alive connection reuse.
issues_found.fix: Add 'io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)' before the status check in metrics and logfwd, matching auditfwd.

issues_found.description: 8 documentation files changed that are unrelated to PXD-0047: VitePress config, custom CSS deleted, agent-lifecycle page deleted and merged into architecture, concepts.md and index.md references updated. This is scope creep.
issues_found.fix: Revert these changes. They should be in a separate commit/PR.

suggested_improvements: Consider extracting the credential resolution logic into a shared internal/credcache package to reduce the triplicated resolveToken implementation (~45 lines identical across three packages). This would make future changes to TTL, caching strategy, or error handling a single-file change.
Add io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body) to metrics and logfwd LocalReporters to match auditfwd and improve HTTP connection reuse.

The auditfwd test helper newTestLocalReporter constructs LocalReporter via struct literal, bypassing NewLocalReporter. Consider using the constructor + overriding httpClient post-construction (as metrics/logfwd do) to ensure constructor logic is exercised.
